adult_evidence: The original publisher places this model in Assets/Avatars/Adults/Female_Adult_01.

preparation.route: FBXDocument reads the original skinned FBX after explicitly loading its original textures. GLTFDocument exports the same mesh level and skin, without the original animation player or footsteps marker. Generated untextured material names identify the separately captured runtime maps.
preparation.specular: Original maps are retained as source references but are not repurposed as roughness maps.

presentation.loading: Direct GLTFDocument reading and explicit Image decoding; an editor import cache is not required.
presentation.skin: Each actor owns its Skeleton3D poses; geometry, skin bindings, textures and materials are shared.
presentation.gait: Pinned source walk and run clips drive named bones, including joint translations. Their imported first frames are stride poses, so leg rotations retain absolute source animation poses in the matching named rig; torso and arm channels remain relative to the first source pose and lowered adult standing pose. Shared clip phase advances only with confirmed horizontal displacement, with a speed-dependent walk/run blend. A presentation-only two-bone correction places hyperextended grounded knees forward while retaining the captured ankle and foot path. Full running weight lowers only the cosmetic visual root by five centimetres toward the unchanged support plane. A cosmetic state machine infers rising, falling and landing from confirmed vertical samples; requested input does not advance animation.
presentation.scale: Uniformly fit the actual skinned standing height to the existing 1.8-metre fixture capsule, with the foot plane 0.9 metres below the body origin.
presentation.authority: No collider, physical actor, input, reach, material quantity, clock or saved state is added.

motion.preparation: Godot 4.7.2 FBX scene import, then copy the 34 named-skeleton position and rotation tracks into a native Animation resource. Footstep markers, horizontal root motion and unused scene nodes are excluded. Source FBX is available at the pinned repository revision.

walk.preparation: Godot 4.7.2 FBX scene import, then copy 56 named-skeleton position and rotation tracks into a native Animation resource. Footstep markers, horizontal root motion and unused scene nodes are excluded. Source FBX is available at the pinned repository revision.

limits: Human assessment of realism, attractiveness, skin, hair and wardrobe remains open.
Passive side and three-quarter visual fixture inspection does not establish human realism judgment, whole-scene quality, GPU performance, physical limb contact or gameplay acceptance.

The captured clips cover walking and running only. Jump and landing remain presentation-authored poses inferred from height samples, without a ground-contact signal or physical limb authority. No facial animation or character customization is included.
Historical fixed source rosters without this folder retain their documented procedural worker.
